subject: Acme: Context length & token volume — pricing follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Acme: Context length & token volume — pricing follow-up

Thanks for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and next steps from our side so we can size pricing and recommend the right serving configuration. Please confirm the numbers below or flag any corrections.

Call notes / ask:
- Main product surface: in-app assistant + doc summarization exports.
- Traffic profile you shared: ~250k API calls / month.
- Profiling you did on sample workload: average prompt tokens ~450, average completion tokens ~950 (so ~1,400 tokens per call on average).
- Long-context usage: ~12% of calls need 32k context, ~3% need 128k context (mostly batch exports / long-doc summarization).
- Target unit economics you mentioned: $20–$30 per 1M tokens as a target price range.

Derived numbers (please sanity-check):
- Estimated total tokens / month = 250k calls * 1,400 tokens = 350,000,000 tokens (~350 x 1M tokens).
- At $25 / 1M tokens that implies ~ $8,750 / month.
- If we price long-context at a premium (32k / 128k) we can provide tiered estimates — see below.

Questions / next steps:
1) Confirm the 250k / month volume and the avg token numbers (450/950). If you have CSV export, please share (attachment stub).
2) Confirm the split between 8k vs 32k vs 128k usage. We noted ~85% 8k-equivalent, 12% 32k, 3% 128k.
3) Do you have a budget range or target monthly spend we should align to for the pilot?
4) I'll loop Jordan (sales engineer) to provide rough sizing (GPU memory, latency/throughput expectations) and a hosted vs dedicated estimate.

Attachments: placeholder for your token_profile CSV (if you send the actual file we'll validate calculations).

Next: if the numbers above look right, Jordan and I can put together a 1-page cost estimate (hosted and dedicated) and a proposed pilot plan (2–4 weeks).

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sasha Nguyen <sasha@acme.com>, Liam O'Connell <liam@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 2 May 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acme: Context length & token volume — pricing follow-up

Thanks for the details — quick SE notes and a rough hosted estimate (attaching 1-pager). High level:

Technical sizing notes:
- With your mix (~85% 8k, 12% 32k, 3% 128k) we recommend a mixed routing approach: default 8k-optimized serving instances and a small pool of 32k/128k-capable nodes for the long-context requests.
- GPU recommendation: 1x A100-80GB (or equivalent quantized runtime on 80GB+) to handle 32k windows with consistent p95 latency; 128k jobs should be batched/offloaded to dedicated long-context nodes or run as batched background jobs to avoid blocking interactive traffic.
- Optimizations to reduce unit cost: prefix caching for common prompts, response length caps for assistant replies (trim extremely long completions), and selective reranking off the critical path.

Estimated tokens and cost (hosted, ballpark per 1M tokens):
- 8k-equivalent traffic (85%): ~297.5M tokens / month => cost @ $22 / 1M = $6,545
- 32k traffic (12%): ~42M tokens / month => premium pricing @ $35 / 1M = $1,470
- 128k traffic (3%): ~10.5M tokens / month => premium pricing @ $120 / 1M = $1,260
- Total estimated monthly cost (hosted, current mix, assuming $22/$35/$120 tiers) = ~$9,275 / month.

Scenarios for pilot budget ($7k–$12k):
- Conservative (reduce completion length via truncation/caching, negotiate $20 / 1M for 8k tier): estimate ~$7,500 / month.
- Expected (mid pricing above): ~$9,275 / month.
- Growth +30% traffic: ~$12,000–$13,500 / month (may justify Dedicated).

Dedicated rough break-even: if committed monthly spend > $10k and traffic grows, dedicated reserved capacity with batching/quantization can reduce unit cost by ~20–30% depending on commitment level. I'll attach a one-page estimate with Hosted vs Dedicated compares + suggested pilot plan.

Attachments: redwood_estimate_acme_v1.pdf (pricing one-pager)

Happy to jump on a technical deep-dive with your infra/ML engineers — propose Wed 5/5 or Thu 5/6.

—Jordan
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.ai
